versions.body:
We know the way.

Kestrel has been delivering for Port Calder since 1998. One hundred and forty vans are on the road every day. In 2023 we moved into the old cannery on Dock Road, and in the autumn of 2025 we took on sixty new people.

Same-day delivery has been available to every address in the city since 10 September 2025. Order by noon, open your door by six.

If you are waiting on a parcel this week, the news page has any service notes.

Same-day in Port Calder: order by noon, delivered by six.

Next-day to the neighbouring towns we cover. Business accounts get a regular window and a named desk, not a chat-bot.

We also move larger freight on our two trucks, booked separately. If you are not sure which service you need, call the Dock Road desk.

The everyday fleet is 140 vans. We also run two trucks for heavier loads, and a small electric-van pilot on short city routes.

We do not publish a live map of every vehicle. If you need a specific van, the depot can tell you whether it is on the road.

All vehicles come back to Dock Road at the end of the shift.

Same-day: every address in Port Calder, including Eastfield, Old Town, the Heights, Northpoint and the harbor side.

Next-day: Ridley and the inland towns on our regular run. If your postcode is not on the list, the desk will say so before you book.

We do not offer same-day outside the city boundary. A map of the same-day area is at the depot, and a simpler version is below this text for anyone booking online.

Kestrel Logistics started in 1998 with a handful of vans and a rented yard. We have been a Port Calder company the whole way.

In 2023 we moved into the former Calder cannery on Dock Road. In 2025 we added sixty jobs there and opened same-day delivery to the whole city. The slogan on the door is the same one on the vans: we know the way.

A list of the organisations we are proud to deliver for is at kestrel-logistics.com/clients.

We hire drivers, warehouse staff and a small night team at Dock Road.

Open roles:
kestrel-logistics.com/careers/driver
kestrel-logistics.com/careers/warehouse
kestrel-logistics.com/careers/night

We do not ask you to pay for a uniform in advance, and we will not interview you only by message. If a listing looks wrong, call the depot and ask.

Applications go through the form on each job page.

Full-time and part-time van drivers, based at Dock Road. A clean licence and a calm head in traffic are the main requirements. City routes, some early starts.

Pay and hours are in the pack we send when you apply. We added routes in 2025 and we are still hiring.

Warehouse staff at the Dock Road depot: inbound, sort, and hand-off to the vans. Day and late shifts. Training is on site.

You do not need prior depot work, but you do need to be able to lift and to stand a full shift. Details in the application pack.

A small night team prepares the first runs of the morning. Shifts start late and end before the depot gets noisy. The work is sorting, loading, and keeping the floor clear.

This is not a driving job. Apply through the form; tell us if you already work days elsewhere so we can talk about hours honestly.

Notes from Kestrel, newest first.

kestrel-logistics.com/news/service-note-26-january
kestrel-logistics.com/news/biscuit
kestrel-logistics.com/news/same-day
kestrel-logistics.com/news/sixty-jobs

For a parcel you are waiting on, see any service note above, or use Track a parcel if you have an account: kestrel-logistics.com/track.

On Sunday one of our drivers went into the harbor at Pier 3 after a dog went through the ice.

The driver has asked not to be named. The dog, a beagle called Biscuit, is recovering. We are glad both of them are safe, and we are proud of the person who did not wait.

The Daily Record also wrote about the rescue the same day.

Some Eastfield deliveries may arrive a day or two late this week.

If your parcel was due today or tomorrow and it has not come, please wait until Wednesday before you call the desk. We are sorry for the delay. There is nothing you need to do on your side.

Kestrel will hire sixty drivers and warehouse staff at Dock Road this autumn. Most of the jobs are full-time.

We moved into the old cannery in 2023. The building has room, and the city has work. Applications will open on the careers page.

title: Same-day to every Port Calder door

versions.body:
From today, Kestrel delivers same-day to every address in Port Calder. Order by noon, open your door by six.

We know the way.

Kestrel Logistics, Dock Road, Port Calder.

The depot desk is open weekdays 7am to 6pm, Saturday 8am to 1pm. If you have a tracking number, have it with you when you call.

Press enquiries go to the same desk and will be passed on. We do not comment on other people's deliveries.

Tracking is for Kestrel account holders and for anyone with a valid tracking number from us.

Sign in on the Kestrel app, or enter your number at the depot desk. We do not open tracking through a public form on this page, and we will not discuss a parcel with someone who cannot give the number or the receiving address.

If you are a business account, your usual desk can also see the run.
